purpose: Reserve previously unexamined event windows before implementing and scoring structural wind candidates.
selection_rule: Compare all candidates; do not tune or select using reserved-event errors.
primary_eligibility: Provider-QC samples at report times require documented station height/duration. Unknown exposure, incomplete uptime and sampled peak censoring remain explicit; no full-event peak claims.
limitations: Annual CSV metadata and the Helene window were previously inspected, but Debby/Milton wind values and residuals have not been examined. Reservation is analyst-level separation, not independence from NHC best-track construction.
